internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: registering the absence of something expected to be present; in Form V, actively reviewing a set to detect what is absent from it
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: All three occurrences turn on noticing that an expected item or member is missing. The two base verbs ask/state what is missing (Pharaoh's men's lost measure at 12:71-72), and the single Form V tafaqqada at 27:20 is Solomon reviewing the birds precisely so as to detect the absent one (he then says 'why do I not see the hoopoe'). The root supplies the registration of a felt absence, not the act of losing, hiding, or searching in general.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does not entail the cause of the loss, moral fault, concealment (contrast the 'unseen' register), or a generic act of searching; the missing item is presupposed to have been present and expected.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 27:20 tafaqqada al-tayr ('he reviewed the birds') could be read as neutral inspection, but the following clause 'why do I not see the hoopoe; was it among the absent' shows the review is oriented to detecting an absent member, preserving the absence nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A generic 'inspect/muster' reading for Form V that drops the absence component; rejected because the 27:20 context foregrounds the detected absentee.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: A generic 'inspect/muster' reading for Form V that drops the absence component; rejected because the 27:20 context foregrounds the detected absentee.
internal_discovery.rationale: Three occurrences across two forms cohere on absence-registration with no resistant case; coverage is complete but the evidence base is small (MODERATE).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: fqd: reject the current universal absence-registration nucleus if a base or Form V occurrence denotes losing, hiding, seeking, or inspecting without any registration that an expected, previously-present item or member is now missing.
rejection_condition.search_location: Batch 07 fqd: all 3 occurrence_dispositions across clusters base_absence_perception and form_v_review_for_absence.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test the absence-registration reading against every supporting_evidence_refs entry and re-examine the 27:20 Form V continuation for an absent referent.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not import a generic 'search' or 'inspect' sense from morphology; the Form V review must be shown to detect an absentee, not merely to examine.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: fqd: narrow the claim to the base-verb absence class and record the Form V as a lexicalized inspection seam rather than asserting a root-wide absence nucleus.
